summary: On-demand redactable activity lake extract with timebox consistency proof and compliance questionnaire bundle
description:
Issue summary:
MercuryBank requests a one-off, tenant-scoped extract of activity data for a 30-day regulatory timebox (2026-02-01 to 2026-03-01) with the following guarantees: ordered, immutable snapshot manifest with RFC3161 timestamp, per-batch HMAC checksums, deterministic field-level provenance mapping, and reversible pseudonymization for a narrow set of PII fields. They also requested a completed compliance questionnaire mapping the delivered artifacts to their auditor checklist.

Impact:
Customer audit window opens 2026-03-20; they cannot proceed with the regulator without the signed export manifest and the questionnaire answers. Business impact: escalated by their legal team; delays may affect certification timeline.

Environment:
- Production tenant: mercury-prod-01
- Region: us-east-1
- Export target: SFTP endpoint (customer provided) or presigned S3 upload (preferred)

Requested deliverables:
1) Gzipped NDJSON export of event records for 2026-02-01 through 2026-03-01, ordered by event_timestamp (UTC).
2) Per-batch (hourly) HMAC SHA-256 checksum file and a chained manifest that includes batch start/end timestamps, record counts, and cumulative checksum.
3) RFC3161 timestamp token applied to the top-level manifest (so auditor has a trusted timestamp).
4) Deterministic field provenance CSV that maps source fields -> export column names -> redaction/pseudonymization status.
5) Reversible pseudonymization (HSM-backed) for fields: email, ssn_token (bank-assigned token), phone_number — reversible only to Redwood SRE on signed legal request.
6) Completed compliance questionnaire (PDF) mapping each artifact to MercuryBank auditor checklist items (they provided checklist v1.4).

Steps to reproduce (N/A - customer request):
- N/A; this is a requested export for regulatory evidence.

Customer-provided notes:
- Preferred delivery: customer SFTP host (details in attachment) but will accept presigned S3 upload if we provide an expiring URL and verify checksums.
- They require the manifest to include a stable UUID per-batch and the root manifest SHA-256 to be included in the questionnaire PDF.

Attachments: customer_sftp_details.csv, auditor_checklist_v1.4.pdf

resolution:
Interim plan provided:
1) Provided sample manifest schema and sample signed manifest (internal RFC3161) to customer 2026-03-11.
2) Security requested signed POA; customer uploaded draft on 2026-03-11. Redwood legal to review POA; once signed, we will enable reversible pseudonymization unwrap for the export.
3) Proposed delivery options and recommended presigned S3 upload for lower operational risk. If customer confirms SFTP, we will schedule a secure transfer runbook and request temporary bastion access.
Next steps (waiting on customer): confirm delivery endpoint and return signed POA by 2026-03-13. Once confirmed, SRE will schedule export window (typical run ~2 hours for 30-day slice) and provide final manifest with RFC3161 token and HMAC proof files.
